Load all parquet files from a cohort directory into DuckDB

Source: R/duckdb_backend.R
load_cohort_parquet_to_duckdb.Rd

Each .parquet file in parquet_dir becomes one table (table name = filename without extension) in schema. Unlike the Postgres loader, this does not stream batches through R or need pre-created DDL: DuckDB reads the parquet directly with CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet(...), inferring column types from the parquet metadata (which arrow wrote with correct types). That native path is the main thing this backend exists to benchmark.

Usage

load_cohort_parquet_to_duckdb(
  con,
  parquet_dir,
  schema,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  table_schema = NULL
)

Arguments

con

A DuckDB DBI connection (from connect_duckdb()).

parquet_dir

Directory of cohort parquet files.

schema

Target schema (created if absent).

overwrite

If TRUE (default), each table is replaced (CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE). If FALSE, a table that already exists with a matching row count is skipped; otherwise it is (re)created.

show_progress

Print per-table progress messages.

table_schema

Optional named list of DuckDB column types, table -> named character vector column -> type. When supplied, tables are cast to this schema as they are materialized.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame of table, rows, seconds.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
con <- connect_duckdb("data/duckdb/mimic_iv_demo.duckdb")
load_cohort_parquet_to_duckdb(con, "data/cohorts_data/mimic_iv_demo_parquet", "mimic_iv_demo_coh")
} # }
